let SourceMatchArrivals = union (Events

| project EventTime_1 = todatetime(["Timestamp"]), GroupCase = ["Case"], GroupUser = ["User"])
| where isnotnull(EventTime_1) and isnotempty(GroupCase) and isnotempty(GroupUser)
| summarize SourceMatchCount = count() by EventTime_1, GroupCase, GroupUser;
union (SourceMatchArrivals
| project GroupCase, GroupUser, CountBoundaryTime = EventTime_1, CountBoundaryOrder = 0, SourceMatchDelta = SourceMatchCount),

| where EventCount >= 2
